summary: Approved as a compatibility-only extension of the locked OncoReady interface: it removes controlled record details from public surfaces, centralizes one prepared-workspace gateway, preserves scenario state and reset semantics, and composes the exact two-plan pricing requirement from existing primitives without global visual changes.
review_scope: Compatibility only. Do not substitute orchestrator aesthetic preferences for frontend specialist design authority.
notes_for_frontend: Implement the report at commit 47de3b899edb6e377c35dc5afaa1cff6e77d0878 exactly as a compatibility extension; preserve all global tokens and established component styling.
Use the existing reducer and persistence as the single scenario source; keep the gateway as local prepared navigation rather than authentication or authorization.
Capture the report's matched desktop and mobile screenshot targets and reject public record leakage, direct gateway bypasses, fake success states, or visual drift.
